verdict: STALE_SOURCE — emitter runs cleanly and produces valid 20.5KB HTML, but reads ONLY the legacy 2026-05-10.md (169 table lines, 6 v7.B/C markers). The v7.1.md (189KB, 493 table lines, 20 v7.B/C markers) is invisible to the companion. SVG/table/UL renders are intact but reflect the pre-revision spec.

findings.title: SPEC_PATH hardcoded to legacy 2026-05-10.md
findings.evidence: Line 36: const SPEC_PATH = 'state/shared/specs/REVENUE-ROADMAP-2026-05-10.md'. v7.1 sits in REVENUE-ROADMAP-v7.1.md at 189KB / 493 rows / 20 v7-markers and is not read.
findings.impact: Companion HTML claims 'v7' but renders pre-round-4 content; v7.B v2 (23 new engines, Gilbert/JC-Merchant fixes) and v7.C v2 (orchestration grounding) never reach the visualization.

findings.title: extractV7BRows uses single 'v7.B'..'v7.C' literal slice
findings.evidence: Line 49-65: extracts between first 'v7.B' and first 'v7.C'. v7.1 has 'v7.B v2' header at line 1064 and 'v7.C v2' header at line 1201 — the regex would still slice but would miss the original v7.B section entirely and conflate v2-revised rows.
findings.impact: Combinatorics table count would silently drop or duplicate; mission asks for 50 rows but current emit shows 53 tr (header + ~52 data rows from old spec).

findings.title: MS_BUCKETS regex misses round-4 IDs
findings.evidence: Line 69-75 patterns: U-REV/U-SUB/U-INV/U-WIRE/U-DRIFT. v7.1 round-4 collapses MS2 42→24 and absorbs U-INV-MILL-06 etc; legacy spec still surfaces 42. SVG node labels hardcoded ('40 units', '18 units', '42 units', '6 units', '4 units') ignore both regex output AND v7.1 reality.
findings.impact: Dep-graph labels lie; viewers see stale unit counts.

findings.title: v7 compliance UL only renders if readiness JSON present
findings.evidence:
Line 226: Object.entries(readiness?.v7_compliance ?? {}). REVENUE-READINESS.json is absent (try/catch silent) so the checklist UL is empty (
    ) — explains ul=1 with zero li.
findings.impact: Compliance block invisible until revenue-readiness-score.mjs runs against v7.1.

findings.title: Tier pie chart empty without readiness JSON
findings.evidence:
renderTierPie() returns '(no tier data yet)' when readiness null; only 1 of 2 SVGs is the dep graph — the second SVG is from the COPY button styling? Actually both SVGs render (dep graph + pie placeholder). Pie shows empty

not SVG when readiness missing.
findings.impact: Mission's 'tier pie chart' requirement fails closed; need readiness regen.

findings.title: HTML title says 'v7' but content is pre-v7.1
findings.evidence: Line 163: <title>PRISM Revenue Roadmap — 2026-05-10 (v7)</title>; should say v7.1 once switched. Footer link points to .md not v7.1.md.
findings.impact: Misleading provenance signal to downstream readers.

render_verification.svg_dep_graph: PRESENT (5 nodes MS0..MS4, 6 edges, viewBox 780x220, dark theme)
render_verification.combo_table_rows: 53 tr elements (1 header + 52 data); mission expected 50 — within tolerance of legacy v7.B which had ~50
render_verification.tier_pie_chart: PLACEHOLDER ONLY ('(no tier data yet)') — readiness JSON missing
render_verification.milestone_unit_count_table: PRESENT (5 rows, regex-derived counts from legacy md)

recommendations.change: Make SPEC_PATH configurable via CLI flag with v7.1 default
recommendations.diff: const argv = process.argv.slice(2); const specArg = argv.find(a=>a.startsWith('--spec=')); const SPEC_PATH = specArg ? specArg.slice(7) : 'state/shared/specs/REVENUE-ROADMAP-v7.1.md';
recommendations.rationale: v7.1 becomes default; legacy still callable via --spec=…2026-05-10.md for diff audits.

recommendations.change: Rewrite extractV7BRows to handle 'v7.B v2' header AND multi-section v7.B
recommendations.diff: Match /^#+\s+v7\.B( v\d+)?/m for start, /^#+\s+v7\.C( v\d+)?/m for end; if both v1 and v2 sections exist, prefer v2 and tag rows with source-version.
recommendations.rationale: v7.1 has both original v7.B (carried) and revised v7.B v2 — current code silently merges or skips.

recommendations.change: Derive SVG node labels from MS_BUCKETS counts (not hardcoded)
recommendations.rationale: Eliminates drift between regex output and graph labels.

recommendations.change: Update <title> to v7.1 and footer link to REVENUE-ROADMAP-v7.1.md
Regen REVENUE-READINESS.json against v7.1 before HTML regen
recommendations.rationale: Unlocks tier-pie, readiness banner, v7-compliance UL — all currently empty.

recommendations.change: Add v7.C tier-grounding table render (engines × dispatchers × v7.B-row × Z3-pattern)
recommendations.diff: New renderV7CGroundingTable() parsing lines 1284-1286 etc. from v7.1.
recommendations.rationale: v7.1's signature contribution (orchestration grounding) has no companion visualization.

recommendations.change: Persist run metadata (spec source, byte sizes, row counts) into <meta> tags
recommendations.rationale: Makes 'which spec did this HTML come from' answerable without scraping body.

summary: Emitter is functionally healthy (clean exit, ~20.5KB output matches target, SVG dep graph + combo table render correctly) but is pointed at a stale source. Switching SPEC_PATH default to v7.1.md + parameterizing via --spec= flag is the single highest-leverage fix. Secondary fixes (dynamic node labels, v7.B v2 section regex, v7.C grounding table render, readiness JSON regen) compound to make the HTML companion faithful to v7.1.
